Amazon Web Services is seeking an Electronic Health Record Principal Sales Executive to drive revenue growth by helping healthcare provider customers adopt Epic on AWS and transform their healthcare organizations as part of this initiative.

Do you have a passion for building relationships with hospital system executives and helping them realize the business value of cloud computing and AI in support of patient care? Would you like to help set the strategy for helping provider customers get the most out of their Epic application, data, and patient care functions?

Do you have a track record of delivering strategic wins and exceeding revenue targets by helping provider customers drive compelling business outcomes? Are you energized by partnering with customers to position AWS as the platform of choice for mission-critical clinical, operations and financial healthcare systems?

Would you like to influence AWS's strategy on how we help our customers drive value in the Epic EHR ecosystem?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced and motivated sales/business development professional who aligns with our Leadership Principles and possesses a unique balance of healthcare industry expertise, is comfortable with C-suite conversations, and has consultative selling skills.

You will own strategy, key customer win goals, and revenue targets across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts, driving adoption of AWS services for Epic EHR workloads.
In collaboration with Solutions Architects, healthcare solution, business development, and partner teams, you will identify key customer accounts, develop account strategies, and lead/coach teams to win strategic multi-year deals.

As a trusted advisor to health system executives, you will help organizations build the business case for migrating Epic environments—including production, alternate production, integrated real-time environments (IRE), data and disaster recovery—to AWS.

You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a go-to-market strategy to build mindshare and accelerate AWS adoption within the healthcare provider segment, specifically focused on Epic EHR.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record of delivering strategic wins and meeting revenue targets while operating at the C-suite level for healthcare providers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value—including TCO reduction, operational resilience, and clinical outcomes—is critical.

You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about territory planning, competitive positioning, and long-term account growth.
We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following: Our company credo: "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Enjoy working with healthcare provider executives. You will have a passion for understanding hospital system priorities—cost optimization, operational efficiency, clinical innovation—and positioning AWS as the platform that delivers on those priorities for Epic EHR and associated clinical workloads.

Have a strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles in healthcare IT.
The ideal candidate will have past experience selling technology solutions to hospital systems, health system C-suites, and IT leadership. You will enjoy developing deep customer relationships and account strategies, leveraging your healthcare domain knowledge to earn trust at the executive level. You will regularly collaborate with Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and AWS service teams to bring the full power of AWS to bear on customer opportunities.

· Own and exceed annual revenue targets by driving AWS adoption for Epic EHR workloads across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts
· Coach and mentor sellers on how to develop winning Epic EHR and ecosystem proposals
· Develop and execute account plans that identify migration opportunities, map stakeholder relationships, and define a path from first engagement through close
· Build and maintain a robust pipeline through prospecting, executive networking, industry events, and collaboration with AWS partner and marketing teams
· Lead complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders—translating technical solution value into financial and operational business outcomes for CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, and clinical leadership
· Partner closely with Solutions Architects to ensure proposed solutions meet customer requirements and position AWS competitively against alternative hosting options
· Engage Systems Integrator (SI) partners to support deal progression, including joint selling motions, SOW development, and commercial structuring
· Negotiate and close multi-year commitments, including Enterprise Discount Programs (EDPs), Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs), and migration-linked investment packages
· Serve as the voice of the customer internally—advocating for product enhancements, service improvements, and go-to-market investments that accelerate Epic on AWS adoption
· Build deep, trust-based relationships with senior executives within hospital systems (CEOs, CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, VP Infrastructure) to establish AWS as a long-term strategic partner
· Contribute to the broader AWS Healthcare sales community by sharing best practices, win/loss insights, and reusable deal strategies

Diverse Experiences — AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture — Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth — We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance — We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

BenefitHub does not currently offer H-1B Sponsorship Position Summary: We're looking for a results driven, relationship-first Account Executive to grow our footprint within the loyalty,membership and association market.

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1 st , 2026, you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Institutional & Specialty divisions, Ecolab offers comprehensive chemical products and solutions to meet the needs of customers across the foodservice and hospitality industries as well as laundry, long-term care, education, corporate and government facilities.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and advisor to your customers. You will serve as the face of Ecolab, providing recommendations on advanced cleaning and sanitation processes and programs that drive a positive guest experience and create cleaner, safer, and healthier environments.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn customers’ ware washing & laundry systems and work hands‑on with equipment, learning installation, maintenance and safe use, ensuring that your customers’ facilities are fully operational and teams are properly trained
Gradually build confidence in identifying new opportunities and growing your territory providing customers with training, regular and emergency service and sales demonstrations
Coordinate sales and service activities with cross divisional peers and internal functions (e.g. Marketing Services, Customer Service).
Reach out to potential customers to secure new accounts, as you build Ecolab’s brand in your market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:

s.h: Have completed vocational training or equivalent education
s.t:
Have some experience in customer‑facing, sales, service or hospitality environments, preferably business to business commercial sales experience
Have basic installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting skills
Are eager to learn, open to feedback and motivated to continuously develop new skills
Have demonstrated problem solving skills and creative thinking
Are comfortable adapting to new situations and challenges
Have a desire to grow your career in Sales and Service-related roles
Have basic IT skills (CRM experience is helpful) Hold a valid driver's license and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record and are open to travelling within your allocated district and nationwide
No Immigration Sponsorship available

A 12‑month fixed‑term contract, that may lead to a permanent position, depending on business need
A robust, structured training programme, that includes job shadowing, e-learning modules, structured field activities, and customized classroom style training, with clear development milestones
A supportive environment where coaching and feedback are part of everyday work, allowing you to learn from subject matter experts with proven success
The opportunity to carve out a long term, advanced career path in sales, within a business that recognises the talent to progress
25 days holiday plus 8 days Bank Holiday
4% Flexible Benefits Allowance. A wide range of benefits (extended to families) or to be used as salary increase
Pension with 7% Employer Contribution and 4 x annual salary Life Insurance benefits
Receive a company vehicle for business and personal use
Income growth opportunities as you progress and develop in the role
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Ecolab, we believe the best teams are diverse and inclusive, and we are on a journey to create a workplace where every associate can grow and achieve their best. We are committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants.

We recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement on the basis of individual qualifications and job performance.

In all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement, we will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, colour, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, disability, or status as a covered veteran.

Process and create efficiencies in workflow

About Accruent
At Accruent, our mission is to transform the way organizations manage their built environment. Through data-led intelligence, we help people and systems work together more effectively, driving business forward. With over 4,000 customers across 149 countries, our cloud-based solutions enable organizations to optimize real estate, facilities, and asset management—delivering real value through efficiency, compliance, and performance.

The Partner Sales Specialist is responsible for managing and optimizing the operational backbone of the partner ecosystem. This role ensures a seamless partner experience across quoting, renewals, onboarding, and lifecycle management, while driving efficiency through process excellence and continuous improvement.
This individual partners cross-functionally with the Partner Team, Deal Enablement, Order Management, Revenue Operations, Technology Partnerships, and Finance to drive operational rigor, visibility, and consistency across all partner-facing processes, while helping operationalize evolving partner program initiatives.

Support and optimize back-end partner operations across recruiting, onboarding, growth, and renewals
Continuously improve operational processes to enhance partner experience and internal efficiency
Drive the quote-to-order process for partner deals, including coordination across systems and teams to enable fast and accurate execution
Manage and optimize renewals workflows to improve retention, minimize churn, and enhance forecast accuracy
Establish proactive renewal management practices (e.g., daily/visual management) to prevent late or missed renewals
Design and implement automated workflows to reduce manual effort and increase scalability of partner support
Leverage the Fortive Business System (FBS), Lean, or similar methodologies to continuously improve processes and eliminate waste
Document and evolve standard work for quoting, renewals, and partner operations
Manage lead routing, tracking, and attribution for partner-driven opportunities
Serve as the primary liaison with technical teams for partner portal development, ongoing management, and issue resolution
Drive portal enhancements to improve usability, self-service, and partner engagement
Refine and operationalize the partner onboarding program to accelerate time-to-revenue
Partner with the Enablement team to develop scalable onboarding and training content
Design and implement systems to track onboarding progress, completion rates, and performance
Partner with leadership to operationalize evolving partner program structures, policies and requirements
Ensure systems, processes, and reporting scale to support future program enhancements

5+ years of experience in Partner Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations (preferably in a SaaS or channel-driven environment)
Strong experience with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and partner portals
Expert in quote and renewal processing
Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation, process design, and optimization
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive alignment
Ability to operate both strategically and tactically in a fast-paced environment
Comfort working in ambiguity with aggressive timelines

Experience supporting channel / partner ecosystems at scale
Familiarity with deal registration, renewal management, and partner lifecycle workflows
Experience optimizing or scaling partner programs

A dynamic, international team environment with colleagues across the globe.
Opportunities to develop, grow, and build your success in a fast-moving SaaS company.
An inclusive culture where new ideas and initiatives are welcomed, and your work has real impact.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.
We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.
At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.
At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.
At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.
Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

Personal development and becoming the best you is all about growth and exploring new skills and opportunities – both in and out of the office. With U.S. headquarters in Austin, Texas, Accruent serves over 5,000 customers in a wide range of industries in more than 100 countries worldwide.

A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.
At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).
Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.
We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our team. You’re someone who is self-motivated to start conversations with enterprise accounts, run outreach campaigns, and turn prospect insights into real pipeline. You'll mix thorough account research with solid follow-through to turn cold leads into booked meetings.

Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Amplemarket, Salesloft, and intent tools to find and map out who key decision-makers are.
Reach out via cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn. With experience you will have the freedom to test creative messaging that gets responses.
Qualify prospects and book discovery calls with AEs to ensure only solid opportunities get passed along.
Reach out to potential attendees of industry events to schedule in-person meetings
Work closely with Account Executives to build territory strategies and share account research to help close bigger deals.
Keep the CRM and Outreach tools updated, track what’s converting, and tweak your messaging based on what’s working.
Consistently meet or exceed your monthly/quarterly targets for meetings booked.
We work and excel as a team. Share as well as learn the best practices from others in the team.
What you need to succeed
1+ years of experience in sales development, business development, or client-facing roles, with a track record of achieving targets.
Strong organizational skills and operational discipline, with the proven ability to manage high-volume outreach across.
Analytical mindset - ability to research industry trends and targets accounts to find the right angle of approach.
Polished verbal and written communication skills, with the presence required to confidently engage senior external stakeholders.
Fluency in English is required. German is a plus.
Understanding and basic experience of CRMs, and sales engagement tools.
The hiring process
An intro call with the People Team.
A call with Subh, our Head of Business Development

What's in it for you at CEEZER
A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.
Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.
True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.
An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.
Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.
A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.
Create an impact with us
We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.
Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.
If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

CEEZER is the leading partner for Climate Performance Asset procurement and management, empowering businesses to transform climate ambition into a clear path to net-zero. Trusted by major organizations including Deutsche Telekom, LGT, and Nasdaq, CEEZER provides the confidence needed to implement effective climate action strategies. The Firearms Specialist provides a Dress Blue Experience, and executes departmental procedures and follows all firearms regulations. Reports to the Department Manager, Assistant Store Manager, Operations Manager or Store Manager.

Focuses on delivering a best in class customer experience and driving strong customer engagement with the firearms department. Focuses on solution based selling, offering applicable accessories and services to the customer in addition to the firearm.

Required to strictly adhere to all governing bodies' processes/requirements including but not limited to: ATF, FFL, DOD, Marine Corps, State, Corporate and local command for selling, handling, receiving, transferring, inventory management, and records management for all weapons and ammunitions.

Communicates with management to support customer inventory requests and general business needs. Uses exception reporting to identify merchandise categories requiring corrective action to protect sales and customer service levels. Follows the special order process according to standard processes.

Supports advertisement and promotional set up requirements including, merchandising, signing, pricing and other tasks as needed. Must be flexible to support the operations of the building/command they work in.

Will actively engage with Sales Managers on all departmental operations including ensuring RIMA (Retail Inventory Management Application) scans are completed and follow through is executed to include inventory adjustments when necessary. Supports and participates year-end inventory planning, execution and researching variance reports.

Will be asked to support store operations in areas of POGs (Planograms), replenishing the sales floor, managing on hand integrity, receiving of products, backroom organization, customer program engagement, cash register duties and other operational tasks both within and outside of the assigned department.

May be periodically assigned to work in other areas of the store (outside firearms) when firearms workload is not present, is significantly diminished, or there is more staffing than required workload within firearms. Mentors, trains and leads by example for firearms employees to achieve best practice and brand standards.

Maintains highest service levels, and communicating with all stakeholders, including customers, associates and all management levels. Completes all required training to maintain Firearms eligibility. May work outside of retail in other firearms activities within MCCS including but not limited to the firing range, or target practice facility.

May maintain some or all key holder standards; Opening, closing, vendor management, light custodial duties and register operations/cash handling. May require additional training, certifications or licenses as required by the business / position including but not limited to, food safety training and military star card access.

Participates in year-end inventory. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. Provides World Class Customer Service with an emphasis on courtesy. Delivers a Dress Blue Experience to all customers throughout the customer's shopping journey every day.

Strongly promotes the cultivation of MCX corporate culture, mission, core values and promotes Marine Corps Community Services at the store level. Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all management and team members through conversations, modeling behaviors, supporting store team-centric initiatives and driving team member satisfaction.

Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of actively supporting the principles of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned. This is a white-collar position where occasional lifting up to 45 lbs. with assistance may be required.

May require loading and unloading of trucks, carts, or pallets.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: One year of sales associate or sales lead experience in a retail environment.Two years of specialty retail experience with firearms, tactical and outdoor sporting goods is preferred. Ability to learn, execute and train operating standards and procedures. Experience leading by example and showcasing best practice customer service and problem solving. Proficient in operating computer with knowledge of Microsoft applications such as Excel, Word and Outlook.

This is a demanding yet rewarding role, offering clear goals and opportunities for professional growth and commercial success! What you’ll be working on As a Sales Executive, you’ll be responsible for the full 360 sales cycle, working closely with our outbound sales team to close new business leads.
Managing Qualified Opportunities: Take ownership of qualified leads passed over by our SDR team, guiding prospects through the sales process from initial discovery to close.
Discovery & Consultative Selling: Conduct engaging discovery calls to understand each customer’s needs, tailor your approach, and demonstrate how our solution can deliver value.

CRM & Sales Administration: Keep accurate records of customer interactions, opportunities, and next steps within our CRM to ensure excellent pipeline visibility and forecasting.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with the SDR team, Team Lead, and wider commercial team to share feedback, improve conversion rates, and continuously refine the customer journey.
What we’re looking for We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-energy environment and is excited by the challenge of turning conversations into customers. You’ll enjoy building relationships, understanding customer needs, and confidently guiding prospects through the sales process. Specifically, you will bring:
Experience in a outbound sales, full 360 sales cycle role where you’ve been responsible for progressing and closing new business opportunities.
Desirable experience if you have worked in a B2B SaaS led environment.
Strong discovery, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence decision-makers.
Confidence handling objections and navigating sales conversations to achieve positive outcomes.
A results-driven mindset, motivated by meeting and exceeding revenue and conversion targets.
Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage a pipeline of opportunities, prioritise follow-ups and keep deals moving forward.
Experience using a CRM to manage your sales pipeline and maintain accurate customer records. Familiarity with HubSpot would be an advantage.
A proactive, resilient attitude and a genuine enthusiasm for helping customers find the right solution.
Required skills & experience We are committed to lifting everyone up. We seek to enable people’s best work by optimising for freedom with accountability.

You’ll get the most out of this role if you can bring: Experience managing B2B sales opportunities from discovery through to close is essential, with a proven ability to build relationships, handle objections and win new business.

Ce qui fait vous, fait Zegna
L-héritage de Zegna n-existerait pas sans les compétences uniques de chaque personne de notre équipe ; les artisans, maîtres, designers et acteurs. Chacun contribue.
En tant que Conseiller Style Boutique Zegna, vous apportez la touche humaine à l-expérience de luxe. Vous êtes notre ambassadeur, partageant à la fois notre riche héritage et nos collections, et offrant un service aussi personnel qu-exceptionnel, façonnant leur perception de notre marque et assurant notre croissance continue et notre héritage.

Plongez dans un environnement de travail pratique et intellectuel où chaque défi et opportunité vous aide à réaliser votre plein potentiel.

About Grubhub
At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried-and-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder , Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.
As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy-to-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience.

We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City, Chicago and Denver, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.
About The Opportunity
The Grubhub Sales Executive role is a great opportunity to leverage your sales skills to make an impact on the company’s rapid growth. Plus, you’ll be selling restaurant owners exactly what they already want: more business. Our current Sales Executive’s love the team events, contests, and of course the meal perks. This is the place to hone your sales skills, and make great money doing it.
You’ll be on the front lines of building Grubhub’s national restaurant partner network. You’ll research and consult with restaurants, contact and meet with decision makers, and show them how Grubhub can benefit their business. You’ll need to be resourceful, persuasive, determined, competitive, and have the ability to easily connect with people from all walks of life.
The Impact You Will Make
Discover Grubhub’s next wave of great local restaurants: We need you to engage the most wanted restaurants in your territory and help us discover those hidden gems our diners are craving.
Be the market expert: gather restaurant feedback, monitor competitor activity, marketing opportunities, and provide recommendations for improvement to management.
Consult with restaurant owners on the benefits of joining GrubHub and having access to our rapidly growing community of hungry diners. Identify needs and goals of the restaurant and demonstrate how Grubhub can help grow their business.
Conduct extensive cold calling (60+ dials per day), emailing, and social outreach to prospective decision makers.
Manage a territory and own the entire sales pipeline from prospecting to closing.
Secure appointments with prospective clients to uncover needs and present the value of a partnership.
Travel into the market to conduct in person sales pitches with merchant owners.
Exceed high-volume sales goals while working within a team environment.

Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen.
